## My Journey Began...
I started this adventure in ESS 523 thinking R was just another 
programming language. Turns out, it's a whole world to explore! 
From the treacherous forests of debugging to the peaks of 
publication-ready plots, here's my travel diary.


::: {.callout-note}
## Why I Travel in Data
I started learning R after I started my masters in Environmental Engineering with a focus on Indoor Air Quality. 
:::

## Travel Stats
- **Countries Visited:** 12 of topics/projects
- **Miles Coded:** ~6,000 lines of code
- **Errors Survived:** Too many to count 😅
- **Coffee Consumed:** Confidential
- **Aha Moments:** Infinite breakthroughs

## What's in My Backpack? 🎒
